neighbours.label: Two unrelated triggers: the 'ule' piece of ' mule' (m|ule) and the Spanish copula ' es' after a name; a list, not a shared pattern
fire: Along the trail we passed a farmer leading a mule loaded with firewood.
In the valley you can often see mule deer grazing at dusk.
The old miner bought a mule to carry his tools up the mountain.
Hunters in Colorado track mule deer through the high meadows.
La casa de mi abuela es un lugar muy tranquilo.
El libro de Carlos es una historia sobre el mar.
La tienda de Marta es un sitio pequeño en el centro.
El perro de Luis es muy grande y muy amable.

predictions: 'mule' items reach 0.5-0.8 and 'X es un/una' Spanish items about 0.4-0.6; the same sentences with another animal or another verb stay under 0.2.
notes: Card: broad, mixed multilingual peaks (Korean 이, 'ule' in mule deer, Arabic ب, Russian вы, Tenman, Spanish ' es'). Probe: mule deer 0.757, 'adriana es un blog' 0.612; Tenman 0.292, вы 0.224 either way, في 0.211; deer without mule 0.114.
